contentText:
Trishla Ostwal / Adweek :

Bluefish, which helps brands manage visibility across AI platforms such as ChatGPT and Claude, raised a $43M Series B, bringing its total funding to $68M   —  Series B brings total funding to $68 million as brands rethink AI visibility  —  If you want to shape media strategy—not just optimize it—upgrade your expertise.
